import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();output=root/'sdk-rs/target/binance-leverage-port'
sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
env=os.environ.copy();env['SAFE_CEX_TYPESCRIPT_PATH']='/Users/sam/cs/tealstreet-next/node_modules/typescript'
results={'sha':sha,'runs':[],'restored':{}}
base=['cargo','test','--manifest-path','sdk-rs/Cargo.toml','-p','safe-cex-venue-binance','--jobs','2']
def run(label,args,assertion=None,totals=(3,)):
 p=subprocess.run(args,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
 (output/(label+'.log')).write_text(p.stdout)
 compiled='Finished `test` profile' in p.stdout
 ok=(p.returncode==101 and compiled and assertion in p.stdout and 'test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored' in p.stdout) if assertion else (p.returncode==0 and compiled and all(p.stdout.count(f'test result: ok. {n} passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored')==totals.count(n) for n in set(totals)))
 row={'label':label,'command':args,'exit':p.returncode,'compiled':compiled,'assertion':assertion,'accepted':ok,'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.stdout.encode()).hexdigest()}
 if assertion:
  lines=p.stdout.splitlines();i=next((i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if assertion in l),None)
  if i is not None:row['assertion_excerpt']=lines[i:i+3]
 results['runs'].append(row);save();print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
 if not ok:raise RuntimeError('FINDING: '+label+' did not discriminate as required; see log')
def save():(output/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
path=root/'sdk-rs/safe-cex-venue-binance/src/leverage.rs';original=path.read_bytes()
assert original==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{sha}:{path.relative_to(root)}'])
try:
 run('baseline',base+['--test','leverage','--','--include-ignored'])
 for label,endpoint,case in [('futures-wrong-endpoint','/fapi/v1/leverage',0),('pm-wrong-endpoint','/papi/v1/um/leverage',69)]:
  token=('"'+endpoint+'"').encode();assert original.count(token)==1
  try:
   path.write_bytes(original.replace(token,('"'+endpoint+'-wrong"').encode()))
   run(label,base+['--test','leverage','leverage_matches_live_source_and_native_store','--','--ignored','--exact'],f'LEVERAGE native endpoint case {case}')
  finally:path.write_bytes(original)
 try:
  token=b'let inherited_market = market.is_none()';assert original.count(token)==1
  path.write_bytes(original.replace(token,b'let inherited_market = std::hint::black_box(false) && market.is_none()'))
  run('inherited-market-guard-bypass',base+['--test','leverage','inherited_market_guard_matches_live_source','--','--ignored','--exact'],'LEVERAGE inherited market native message case 0')
 finally:path.write_bytes(original)
finally:
 results['restored'][str(path.relative_to(root))]=path.read_bytes()==original;save()
 assert all(results['restored'].values())
run('final-restore',base+['--test','leverage','--test','pm_orders','--','--include-ignored'],totals=(3,2))
